children: RNS Number : 1948W  Upland Resources Limited  25 September 2026
Upland Resources Limited (LSE: UPL.L) (OTCQB: UPLLF),is pleased to announce the publication of its Interim Results for the six-month period ended 30 June 2026 (the "2026 Interim Results").
The 2026 Interim Results will be available to view at the following link: https://upland.energy/financial-reports/
Upland Resources Limited (LSE: UPL.L), (OTCQB: UPLLF) is a Southeast Asian-focused oil and gas company pursuing opportunities across Southeast Asia and the United States.

The Company's strategy is centred on identifying and developing energy opportunities with the potential to deliver long-term value for shareholders through strategic investments, partnerships and participation in assets with significant resource potential.
Further information on the Company is available at: www.upland.energy

This announcement contains inside information for the purposes of Article 7 of the UK Market Abuse Regulation (EU) No. 596/2014, which forms part of UK domestic law by virtue of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018 ("UK MAR"). This information is disclosed in accordance with the Company's obligations under Article 17 of UK MAR.

This announcement does not constitute, and should not be construed as, a prospectus, admission document or offering memorandum, nor an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any securities in the Company. No securities of the Company are being offered pursuant to this announcement.
